raw.query: WITH stage AS (SELECT i.run_id, i.sla_metric, i.bound_ms, i.bound_stat, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.n_requests, p.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_infraction i JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id=i.run_id AND d.pool IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.pool AND d.window_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.window_name JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id=i.run_id AND p.sla_metric=i.sla_metric WHERE i.is_current AND p.is_current AND d.is_current AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND i.sla_metric IN ('encoder_delay','ttft') AND i.run_id IN ('a14:chronos_composed','a14:chronos_e2e')), windows AS (SELECT window_name, n_requests, encoder_delay_p99_ms, ttft_p99_ms, e2e_p99_ms, e2e_p99_is_request_linked, e2e_vs_sum_evidence FROM provenance.v_joint_e2e WHERE arm='fc_chronos') SELECT sum(bound_ms) AS summed_stage_budget_ms, min(bound_stat) AS stage_bound_stat, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('run_id',run_id,'metric',sla_metric,'bound_ms',bound_ms,'p99_ms',p99_ms,'n_requests',n_requests) ORDER BY sla_metric) AS stages, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('window',window_name,'n_requests',n_requests,'encoder_p99_ms',encoder_delay_p99_ms,'ttft_p99_ms',ttft_p99_ms,'e2e_p99_ms',e2e_p99_ms,'request_linked',e2e_p99_is_request_linked,'sum_evidence',e2e_vs_sum_evidence) ORDER BY window_name) FROM windows) AS per_window FROM stage
raw.observed: The two current, non-superseded p99 budgets sum to 2000 ms; aggregate encoder and TTFT p99s are 588.37 and 651.1395369768143 ms over 749601 requests, while the request-linked aggregate E2E p99 is 1239.5 ms and is labelled coincides_with_sum.
raw.claimed: Approximately 2 seconds at roughly p98, plus a modelled ingress-to-first-token p99 of approximately 1.3 seconds independently confirmed by the measured join.
raw.evidence: The 2000 ms union-bound budget is supported, but the DB supplies a 1239.5 ms request-linked join and labels its equality with the stage-p99 sum as coincidence, not independent confirmation of a separate modelled reconstruction.
raw.fix: State that two 1000 ms p99 stage budgets yield a 2000 ms p98 union-bound budget, and that the measured request-linked aggregate E2E p99 is 1239.5 ms; remove the unsupported modelled-confirmation framing.
